Original UI Atlas image transitions using native Web Animations. Original local SVG illustrations; no third-party photographs or image services. Studies are accessed inside Atlas; internal image-preview.html redirects standalone visits to Explore. Embedded previews cycle automatically and offer chapter buttons. Offscreen frames are disposed by Atlas. Reduced motion switches images instantly. Source: image-studies.js and image-studies.css. Motion is a related implementation option, not the runtime used by these studies.
